Cubic yards to tons

Volume in cubic yards = L × W × depth(in) ÷ 12 ÷ 27. Quarries sell by the ton, so multiply by density. Common crushed stone and pea gravel weigh about 1.3–1.5 tons per cubic yard; 1.4 is a sensible default. Ask your supplier for the exact figure for their material.

Typical depths

  • Walkway: 2–3 in of decorative gravel over landscape fabric
  • Driveway: 4–6 in base layer (larger crushed stone) plus 2 in top layer
  • Patio/paver base: 4 in compacted base

Compaction

Crushed base compacts roughly 10–15%, so order a little extra for layers you plan to tamp.

FAQ

How accurate is the gravel calculator?

It uses the standard formula shown on this page and rounds bags, boxes and pieces up to whole units. Product sizes vary by brand, so confirm with the label or your supplier before you buy.

Should I buy extra material?

Yes. A 5–10% allowance covers cuts, spills and uneven surfaces; running short mid-job usually costs more than a few leftovers.

Is this calculator free?

Yes. Every PorchMath calculator is free, needs no account and runs entirely in your browser.
